notes.title: 🔥 Anomaly 13 will be available on Steam starting August 1st!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][b]Dear friends,[/b][/p][p]Our game will be released on August 1st!
To celebrate this important event, we're happy to offer you a [b]10% launch discount[/b].
Thank you for being with us![/p][p][/p][p][b]For press and content creators:[/b][/p][p]Want to receive a key on release day?
Send us a message in advance at [/p][p][url="https://wizardgamessup@outlook.com"]wizardgamessup@outlook.com[/url][/p][p]
with the subject line [b]“Anomaly 13 — Press Key”[/b].
Please include links to your media outlet or channel![/p][p][/p][p][b]Join our community:[/b]
\[[url="https://t.me/wizardgamesdev"]Telegram[/url] / [url="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCv8Tqox7ehbNf0L9You-v2Q"]YouTube[/url]][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]P.S.[/b] If you enjoy the game, please leave a review — it really helps support the project![/p][p]Best regards,
[b]Wizard Games[/b][/p]
